/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectAbnormalEntryList : 하기이상결과보고 entry List */ SELECT od.HBL_NO ,od.HSN ,od.PIECES AS HBL_PIECES ,od.GWT AS HBL_GWT ,od.DEST_CODE ,od.MBL_NO ,abnormal.PIECES ,abnormal.GWT ,abnormal.ABNORMAL_CODE ,abnormal.CNT ,abnormal.DISC_WH_CODE ,abnormal.AR_DATE ,abnormal.MRN ,abnormal.MSN ,abnormal.VESSEL_FLIGHT ,abnormal.OD_JOB_NO ,abnormal.SEQ_NO_ID ,CASE abnormal.SEQ_NO_ID WHEN 2 THEN 'N' ELSE ISNULL((SELECT 'Y' FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND SEQ_NO_ID = 2), 'N') END AS SEND_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL abnormal ON abnormal.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{srchMasterOdJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
AND abnormal.ABNORMAL_CODE = #{srchAbnormalCode}

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectBmsInPlanAbnormalEntryList : 하기이상결과보고 entry List(반입예정데이터) */ SELECT bip.BL_NO AS HBL_NO ,SUBSTRING(bip.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 16, 4) AS HSN ,bip.EX_CT AS HBL_PIECES ,bip.EX_WT AS HBL_GWT ,bip.MBL_NO ,abnormal.PIECES ,abnormal.GWT ,abnormal.ABNORMAL_CODE ,abnormal.CNT ,abnormal.DISC_WH_CODE ,abnormal.AR_DATE ,abnormal.MRN ,abnormal.MSN ,abnormal.VESSEL_FLIGHT ,abnormal.OD_JOB_NO ,abnormal.SEQ_NO_ID ,CASE abnormal.SEQ_NO_ID WHEN 2 THEN 'N' ELSE ISNULL((SELECT 'Y' FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), bip.IN_PLAN_NO) AND SEQ_NO_ID = 2), 'N') END AS SEND_YN FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN bip WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL abnormal ON abnormal.OD_JOB_NO = CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), bip.IN_PLAN_NO) WHERE bip.MBL_NO = #{srchMblNo}
AND abnormal.ABNORMAL_CODE = #{srchAbnormalCode}

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectAbnormalDeclareList : 배송지변경신고 List */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
WITH Main_CTE AS( SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT X.* ,(SELECT CONCAT('H.B/L ',NAME_${userLanguage}) FROM exps_master.dbo.TB_SMS_MESSAGE WHERE MESSAGE_ID = CASE MOD_TYPE WHEN '05' THEN 'EXPS003300' WHEN '06' THEN 'EXPS001554' WHEN '07' THEN 'EXPS001463' END) AS MOD_TYPE_NAME FROM( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,odAdnor.SEQ_NO_ID ,odAdnor.AR_DATE ,odAdnor.MRN ,odAdnor.MSN ,od.MBL_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.PO_DATE ,od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO ,od.HSN ,od.DEST_CODE ,od.DEST_PORT ,od.VESSEL_FLIGHT
,CASE WHEN odAdnor.ABNORMAL_CODE = 'MFN' THEN 0 ELSE od.PIECES END AS HBL_PIECES ,CASE WHEN odAdnor.ABNORMAL_CODE = 'MFN' THEN 0 ELSE od.GWT END AS HBL_GWT ,SUM(CASE WHEN odAdnor.ABNORMAL_CODE = 'MFN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) OVER (PARTITION BY od.OD_JOB_NO) AS MFN_CNT ,odAdnor.PIECES ,odAdnor.GWT ,odAdnor.CNT ,odAdnor.ABNORMAL_CODE ,CONCAT(odAdnor.ABNORMAL_CODE, '.', (SELECT NAME_KOR FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CODE = odAdnor.ABNORMAL_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'ABNORMALITY_CODE')) AS ABNORMAL_CODE_NAME ,odAdnor.DISC_WH_CODE ,odAdnor.SEND_DATE ,odAdd.CARRYIN_DATE ,odAdd.UNMANAGEMENT_DATE ,odAdd.MF_CORRECTION_DATE ,odAdd.MF_CORRECTION_CONTENTS ,odAdd.ABNORMAL_MFN_DATE ,odAdd.ABNORMAL_MFN_YN ,od.MRN AS MOD_MRN ,od.SHIPPER_NAME ,od.SHIPPER_TEL ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,od.PIECES AS MOD_PIECES ,od.GWT AS MOD_GWT ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM ,od.BOUND
,(SELECT NAME_DEFAULT FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CODE = odAdd.LAST_POD_STATUS) AS LAST_POD_STATUS
,odAdd.LAST_POD_STATUS
,(SELECT TOP 1 MOD_TYPE FROM TB_EDI_MOD_HBL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE_TIME DESC) AS MOD_TYPE
,od.VENDER_ID_1 as VENDER_ID1 ,(SELECT SEND_DATE FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND SEQ_NO_ID = 2) AS MGN_MFN_SEND_DATE
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL
,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL
FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD mod ON od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = mod.OD_JOB_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL odAdd ON od.OD_JOB_NO = odAdd.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL odAdnor ON od.OD_JOB_NO = odAdnor.OD_JOB_NO AND odAdnor.SEQ_NO_ID = 1 WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND ISNULL(odAdnor.SEND_DATE,'') <> ''
AND ${srchNoType} IN (#{item})
AND ${srchNoType} LIKE CONCAT('%',#{srchNo},'%')
AND ${srchDateGbn} >= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
AND CONVERT(DATE, ${srchDateGbn}, ${srchDateFormat}) <= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
AND odAdnor.ABNORMAL_CODE = #{srchAbnormalCode}
AND ISNULL(odAdd.UNMANAGEMENT_DATE,'') <> ''
AND ISNULL(odAdd.UNMANAGEMENT_DATE,'') = ''
AND ISNULL(odAdd.MF_CORRECTION_DATE,'') <> ''
AND ISNULL(odAdd.MF_CORRECTION_DATE,'') = ''
AND odAdd.ABNORMAL_MFN_YN = 'Y'
AND (odAdd.ABNORMAL_MFN_YN = 'N' OR odAdd.ABNORMAL_MFN_YN IS NULL)
AND odAdd.CARRYIN_DATE IS NOT NULL AND odAdd.CARRYIN_DATE <> ''
AND (odAdd.CARRYIN_DATE IS NULL OR odAdd.CARRYIN_DATE = '')
) X ) A
) , Count_CTE AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL FROM Main_CTE ) SELECT *
, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
, ${defaultSort2}
) AS NUM FROM Count_CTE, Main_CTE
, ${defaultSort2}
OFFSET ${startNum} ROWS FETCH NEXT ${pageSize} ROWS ONLY

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectBmsAbnormalDeclareList : 하기이상보고 저장 조회 */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.OD_JOB_NO , A.SEQ_NO_ID , A.ABNORMAL_CODE , A.LAST_POD_STATUS , A.MRN , A.MSN , A.HSN , A.MBL_NO , A.HBL_NO
, A.EX_CT AS HBL_PIECES , A.EX_WT AS HBL_GWT , A.VESSEL_FLIGHT , A.DISC_WH_CODE , A.AR_DATE , A.PIECES , A.GWT , A.CNT
, ISNULL(STUFF(( SELECT DISTINCT ','+ PA.ABNORMAL_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD_PANTOS_ABNORMAL PA WHERE PA.MRN = A.MRN FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, ''), '') AS ABNORMAL_CODE_NAME
, A.SEND_DATE , A.DECLARATION_DATE , ISNULL(G.SEND_DATE, '') AS MGN_SEND_DATE , ISNULL(F.SEND_DATE, '') AS MFN_SEND_DATE , CASE WHEN ISNULL(G.OD_JOB_NO, '') <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS MGN_YN , CASE WHEN ISNULL(F.OD_JOB_NO, '') <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS MFN_YN , ISNULL(F.SEND_DATE, '') AS ABNORMAL_MFN_DATE , CASE WHEN ISNULL(F.OD_JOB_NO, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(F.OD_JOB_NO, '') <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ABNORMAL_MFN_YN , A.REGISTER_USER_ID , A.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , A.UPDATE_USER_ID , A.UPDATE_DATE_TIME , A.MANIFEST_DEL_YN , A.LAST_POD_RAQ_DATE , CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, G.SEND_DATE, GETDATE()) > 13 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS NOT_PROCESS_YN , CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DAY, G.SEND_DATE, GETDATE()) <= 15 AND (A.MANIFEST_DEL_YN = 'N' OR P.IN_YN = 'N') THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, G.SEND_DATE, GETDATE()) ELSE -1 END AS MGN_MARK_DATE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.MRN ORDER BY A.REGISTER_DATE_TIME DESC, A.OD_JOB_NO) AS RN , P.ORIG_COUNTRY , CAST(I.CARRYIN_DATE + ' ' + I.CARRYIN_TIME AS DATETIME) AS CARRYIN_DATE , B.TOTAL_HBL FROM TB_ECM_OD_PANTOS_ABNORMAL A WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_PANTOS_ABNORMAL G WITH (NOLOCK) ON G.MRN = A.MRN AND G.ABNORMAL_CODE = 'MGN' LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_PANTOS_ABNORMAL F WITH (NOLOCK) ON F.MRN = A.MRN AND F.ABNORMAL_CODE = 'MFN'
LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN P WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.MBL_NO = P.MBL_NO AND A.HBL_NO = P.BL_NO LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN I WITH (NOLOCK) ON I.IN_PLAN_NO = P.IN_PLAN_NO CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT HBL_NO) AS TOTAL_HBL FROM TB_ECM_OD_PANTOS_ABNORMAL A WITH (NOlOCK)
LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN P WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.MBL_NO = P.MBL_NO AND A.HBL_NO = P.BL_NO
WHERE 1=1
AND A.ABNORMAL_CODE = #{srchAbnormalCode}
AND ${srchNoType} IN (#{item})
AND ${srchNoType} LIKE CONCAT('%',#{srchNo},'%')
AND ${srchDateGbn} >= CONVERT(CHAR(10), #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
AND ${srchDateGbn} < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CONVERT(CHAR(10), #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat}))
AND ISNULL(A.SEND_DATE,'') <> ''
AND ISNULL(A.SEND_DATE,'') = ''
AND P.IN_YN = 'Y'
AND P.IN_YN IN ('N','C')
) B WHERE 1 = 1
AND A.ABNORMAL_CODE = #{srchAbnormalCode}
AND ${srchNoType} IN (#{item})
AND ${srchNoType} LIKE CONCAT('%',#{srchNo},'%')
AND ${srchDateGbn} >= CONVERT(CHAR(10), #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
AND ${srchDateGbn} < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CONVERT(CHAR(10), #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat}))
AND ISNULL(A.SEND_DATE,'') <> ''
AND ISNULL(A.SEND_DATE,'') = ''
AND P.IN_YN = 'Y'
AND P.IN_YN IN ('N','C')
) t WHERE t.RN = 1
mapper.insert: /* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.insertAbnormalList : 하기이상결과보고 insert */ INSERT INTO TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL ( OD_JOB_NO , SEQ_NO_ID , ABNORMAL_CODE , MRN , MSN , VESSEL_FLIGHT , DISC_WH_CODE , AR_DATE , PIECES , GWT , CNT , REGISTER_USER_ID , REGISTER_DATE_TIME , UPDATE_USER_ID , UPDATE_DATE_TIME) SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SEQ_NO_ID),0) + 1 FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO ) , #{abnormalCode} , mod.MRN , mod.MSN , mod.VESSEL_FLIGHT , #{discWhCode} , mod.AR_DATE , #{pieces} , #{gwt} , #{cnt} ,#{registerUserId} ,DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) ,#{registerUserId} ,DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD mod ON od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = mod.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo};
mapper.update:
/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.updateLastPodMax : 하기이상결과보고신고 삭제건 last pod update */ UPDATE ad SET LAST_POD_STATUS = pod.POD_STATUS
FROM TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TOP 1 A.OD_JOB_NO, A.POD_STATUS, A.POD_DATE, A.POD_TIME FROM( SELECT #{odJobNo} AS OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = (SELECT MASTER_OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}) AND POD_STATUS IN ('ECM060','ECM070') UNION ALL SELECT #{odJobNo} AS OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = (SELECT MASTER_OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}) AND POD_STATUS IN ('ECM060','ECM070') UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND POD_STATUS NOT IN ('ECM060','ECM070') UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_01 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND POD_STATUS NOT IN ('ECM060','ECM070') UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_02 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_03 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} UNION ALL SELECT OD_JOB_NO, POD_STATUS, POD_DATE, POD_TIME FROM TB_ECM_POD_04 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND POD_STATUS IN ('ECM400', 'ECM420') ) A ORDER BY A.POD_STATUS DESC ) pod ON pod.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO WHERE ad.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
mapper.insert: /* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.insertSpecialItem : 별도관리물품 insert */ INSERT INTO TB_ECM_OD_SPECIAL_ITEM ( OD_JOB_NO , SEQ_NO_ID , MANAGE_TYPE , AR_DATE , FLIGHT_NO , DEST_PORT , PIECES , ITEM_DESC , GWT ) SELECT #{odJobNo} ,(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SEQ_NO_ID),0) + 1 FROM TB_ECM_OD_SPECIAL_ITEM WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} ) , '2' , od.AR_DATE , od.VESSEL_FLIGHT , od.DEST_PORT , od.PIECES , od.COMMODITY_ITEM , od.GWT FROM TB_ECM_OD od WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{mfnOdJobNo}

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.insertMblCorrectByAb : 적하정정 insert */ INSERT INTO TB_EDI_MOD_MBL( MOD_JOB_NO ,ENT_CODE ,ENT_BUSINESS_CODE ,SOLUTION ,BOUND ,MRN ,MSN ,MBL_NO ,MOD_TYPE ,HBL_CNT ,MOD_SERIAL_NO ,MOD_REQ_NO ,MOD_REQ_DATE ,CUSTOMS_CODE ,CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE ,REGISTER_USER_ID ,REGISTER_DATE_TIME ) SELECT TOP 1 #{modJobNo} ,od.ENT_CODE ,od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE ,#{solution} ,od.BOUND ,od.MRN ,od.MSN ,od.MBL_NO ,#{modType} ,#{hblCnt} ,#{modSerialNo} ,#{modReqNo} ,DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) ,CASE WHEN od.BOUND_TYPE = 'EXP' THEN code.ETC3 ELSE code.ETC7 END ,CASE WHEN od.BOUND_TYPE = 'EXP' THEN code.ETC4 ELSE code.ETC8 END ,#{registerUserId} ,DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL code ON code.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND code.GROUP_CODE = 'ECM_CUSTOMS_DPT' AND code.CODE = CASE WHEN od.BOUND_TYPE = 'EXP' THEN od.ORIG_CODE ELSE od.DEST_CODE END WHERE od.MBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(#{mblNo},char(9),''))) AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'M'
mapper.select:
/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectAbnormalHouseList : 정정데이터 생성할 하우스 조회 */
WITH TMP AS( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.HSN ,cntr.CNTR_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_CONTAINER cntr ON cntr.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
AND cntr.CNTR_NO = #{cntrNo}
AND cntr.CNTR_NO IN (#{item.cntrNo})
WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item.odJobNo})
) SELECT t.OD_JOB_NO ,MAX(t.HBL_NO) AS HBL_NO ,MAX(t.HSN) AS HSN ,STUFF((SELECT '|' + CNTR_NO FROM TMP WHERE OD_JOB_NO = t.OD_JOB_NO FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS CNTR_NO_LIST FROM TMP t GROUP BY t.OD_JOB_NO
SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.HSN
,od.VESSEL_FLIGHT ,od.VOYAGE ,od.DEST_CODE ,od.AR_DATE ,od.SHIPPER_NAME ,CONCAT(ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS SHIPPER_ADDRESS ,od.SHIPPER_TEL ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,CONCAT(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM ,od.UNIT_PIECES ,od.GWT
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL
,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL
FROM TB_ECM_OD od
WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item.odJobNo})

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectAbnormalCntrInfo : 정정데이터 생성할 컨테이너 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 MAX(cntr.CNTR_NO) AS CNTR_NO ,COUNT(cntr.OD_JOB_NO) AS CNTR_CNT
FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_CONTAINER cntr ON cntr.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
FROM TB_ECM_OD_CONTAINER cntr
WHERE cntr.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
WHERE cntr.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item})
WHERE cntr.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item.odJobNo})
AND cntr.CNTR_NO IN(#{item})
AND cntr.CNTR_NO IN(#{item})
GROUP BY cntr.OD_JOB_NO ORDER BY CNTR_CNT DESC

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectAbnormalCntrInfoList : 정정데이터 생성할 컨테이너 조회 */ SELECT cntr.CNTR_NO ,cntr.OD_JOB_NO
FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_CONTAINER cntr ON cntr.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
FROM TB_ECM_OD_CONTAINER cntr
WHERE cntr.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
WHERE cntr.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item})
WHERE cntr.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item.odJobNo})
AND cntr.CNTR_NO IN(#{item}) ORDER BY cntr.OD_JOB_NO

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectAbnormalChk : 하기이상저장 전 체크 */ SELECT od.MBL_NO ,od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO ,hod.HBL_NO ,hod.OD_JOB_NO
,(SELECT TOP 1 OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = hod.OD_JOB_NO AND ABNORMAL_CODE NOT IN('MGN','SHT')) AS ABNORMAL_CODE_DUP
,(SELECT TOP 1 OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = hod.OD_JOB_NO) AS ABNORMAL_CODE_DUP
,(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(HSN), 0) FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND BL_TYPE_MH = 'H') AS MAX_HSN FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD hod ON hod.MBL_NO = od.MBL_NO AND hod.HBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{HBL_NO}))
WHERE od.MBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{MBL_NO}))
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'M'
AND od.BOUND_TYPE = 'IMP'

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectBmsInPlanAbnormalChk : 하기이상저장 전 체크(반입예정데이터) */ SELECT TOP 1 bip.MBL_NO , '' AS MASTER_OD_JOB_NO , bip.BL_NO AS HBL_NO , bip.OD_JOB_NO AS OD_JOB_NO , SUBSTRING(bip.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 12, 4) AS MSN , SUBSTRING(bip.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 16, 4) AS HSN , bip.EX_CT AS EX_CT , bip.EX_WT AS EX_WT , bip.ORIG_COUNTRY AS ORIG_COUNTRY
,(SELECT TOP 1 OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD_PANTOS_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND ABNORMAL_CODE = #{abnormalCode} AND ABNORMAL_CODE NOT IN('MGN','SHT')) AS ABNORMAL_CODE_DUP
,(SELECT TOP 1 OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD_PANTOS_ABNORMAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND ABNORMAL_CODE = #{abnormalCode}) AS ABNORMAL_CODE_DUP
,'' AS MAX_HSN FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN bip WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE bip.BL_NO = TRIM(#{hblNo})
AND bip.MBL_NO = TRIM(#{mblNo})
ORDER BY bip.REGISTER_DATE_TIME DESC

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectNoCargoYn : 하기이상결과보고 무적 체크 */ SELECT 'Y' AS NOT_NO_CARGO_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD_PANTOS_ABNORMAL WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE MRN = TRIM(#{mrn}) AND MBL_NO = TRIM(#{mblNo}) AND HBL_NO = TRIM(#{hblNo}) AND ABNORMAL_CODE = TRIM(#{abnormalCode})

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectBmsSeqNoId : 하기이상코드 인덱스 조회 */ SELECT CASE WHEN CODE = 'IND' THEN '17' WHEN CODE = 'OPN' THEN '18' WHEN CODE = 'RET' THEN '19' ELSE DISPLAY_INDEX END AS DISPLAY_INDEX FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND CODE = #{abnormalCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'ABNORMALITY_CODE'

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.getNoRegisterCount : 하기이상 체크할 하우스 리스트 조회 */ SELECT COUNT(A.MGN) AS MGN_CNT ,COUNT(A.OTHER) AS OTHER_CNT ,COUNT(A.MGN_MFN) AS MGN_MFN_CNT ,COUNT(A.OD_JOB_NO) AS TOTAL_CNT FROM ( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,MAX(CASE WHEN ab.ABNORMAL_CODE IN('MGN', 'SHT') THEN 1 END) AS MGN ,MAX(CASE WHEN ab.ABNORMAL_CODE NOT IN('MGN', 'SHT') THEN 1 END) AS OTHER ,CASE WHEN MAX(ab.ABNORMAL_CODE) IN('MGN', 'SHT') AND MIN(ab.ABNORMAL_CODE) = 'MFN' THEN 1 END AS MGN_MFN FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL ab ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ab.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
GROUP BY od.OD_JOB_NO ) A

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectHouseList : 마스터로 하우스 리스트 조회 */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY HSN) AS SEQ , A.OD_JOB_NO AS odJobNo , A.HBL_NO AS hblNo , A.HSN AS hsn FROM( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO , od.HBL_NO , od.HSN FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
) A

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectHouseListMgnMfn : MGN or SHT후 MFN생성가능한 데이터 조회 */ SELECT A.OD_JOB_NO AS odJobNo, A.HBL_NO AS hblNo, A.PIECES AS pieces FROM ( SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,MAX(od.HBL_NO) AS HBL_NO ,MAX(od.PIECES) AS PIECES ,MIN(ab.ABNORMAL_CODE) AS ABNORMAL_CODE_MIN FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ad.OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL ab ON od.OD_JOB_NO = ab.OD_JOB_NO AND ab.ABNORMAL_CODE IN('MGN', 'SHT', 'MFN') WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
GROUP BY od.OD_JOB_NO ) A WHERE A.ABNORMAL_CODE_MIN != 'MFN'

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectSendAbnormalities : 하기결과이상보고 대상 조회 */ SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,MAX(od.MBL_NO) AS MBL_NO ,MAX(od.MRN) AS MRN ,MAX(od.MSN) AS MSN ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), MAX(od.AR_DATE), 112) AS AR_DATE ,MAX(od.VESSEL_FLIGHT) AS VESSEL_FLIGHT ,MAX(od.DEST_CODE) AS DEST_CODE ,MAX(od.CUSTOMS_CODE) AS CUSTOMS_CODE ,MAX(od.CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE) AS CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE ,MAX(abnormal.ABNORMAL_CODE) AS ABNORMAL_CODE ,MAX(abnormal.MRN) AS MRN_ABNORMAL ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), MAX(abnormal.AR_DATE), 112) AS AR_DATE_ABNORMAL ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) AS ISSUE_DATE ,MAX(od.LINE_CODE) AS LINE_CODE ,MAX(od.VENDER_ID_1) AS EDI_VENDER FROM TB_ECM_OD houseOd INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ABNORMAL abnormal ON abnormal.OD_JOB_NO = houseOd.OD_JOB_NO AND abnormal.SEND_DATE IS NULL INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD od ON houseOd.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE houseOd.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item.odJobNo}) GROUP BY od.OD_JOB_NO

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectAddPopupSearchList : 하기결과이상보고 - 추가 팝업 조회 */ SELECT bip.OD_JOB_NO AS OD_JOB_NO , SUBSTRING(bip.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 1, 11) AS MRN , bip.VESSEL_FLIGHT AS VESSEL_FLIGHT , bip.ORIG_COUNTRY AS ORIG_COUNTRY , bip.AR_DATE AS AR_DATE , bip.MBL_NO AS MBL_NO , bip.BL_NO AS HBL_NO , ISNULL(ISNULL(abnormal.EX_CT, bip.EX_CT), 0) AS HBL_PIECES , ISNULL(ISNULL(abnormal.EX_WT, bip.EX_WT), 0) AS HBL_GWT , ISNULL(ISNULL(abnormal.PIECES, bip.EX_CT), 0) AS PIECES , ISNULL(ISNULL(abnormal.GWT, bip.EX_WT), 0) AS GWT , ISNULL(abnormal.CNT, 0) AS CNT , ISNULL(abnormal.ABNORMAL_CODE, '') AS ABNORMAL_CODE , SUBSTRING(bip.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 1, 11) AS MRN_ORG , ISNULL(ISNULL(abnormal.EX_CT, bip.EX_CT), 0) AS HBL_PIECES_ORG , ISNULL(ISNULL(abnormal.EX_WT, bip.EX_WT), 0) AS HBL_GWT_ORG , ISNULL(ISNULL(abnormal.PIECES, bip.EX_CT), 0) AS PIECES_ORG , ISNULL(ISNULL(abnormal.GWT, bip.EX_WT), 0) AS GWT_ORG , ISNULL(abnormal.CNT, 0) AS CNT_ORG FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN bip WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD_PANTOS_ABNORMAL abnormal WITH (NOLOCK) ON abnormal.OD_JOB_NO = bip.OD_JOB_NO AND abnormal.ABNORMAL_CODE = #{abnormalCode} WHERE bip.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectAddPopupSrchBlNoList : 하기결과이상보고 - 추가 팝업 다중 BL 조회 */ SELECT bip.OD_JOB_NO AS OD_JOB_NO , SUBSTRING(bip.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 1, 11) AS MRN , bip.VESSEL_FLIGHT AS VESSEL_FLIGHT , bip.ORIG_COUNTRY AS ORIG_COUNTRY , bip.AR_DATE AS AR_DATE , bip.MBL_NO AS MBL_NO , bip.BL_NO AS HBL_NO , bip.EX_CT AS HBL_PIECES , bip.EX_WT AS HBL_GWT , ISNULL(bip.EX_CT, 0) AS PIECES , ISNULL(bip.EX_WT, 0) AS GWT , 0 AS CNT FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN bip WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE bip.BL_NO = (SELECT TOP 1 BL_NO FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN P WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE P.BL_NO = #{blNo} ORDER BY P.UPDATE_DATE_TIME DESC)

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectMaxAbnormalBlCnt : 하기결과이상보고 - 추가 팝업 다중 BL 조회 */ SELECT RIGHT(REPLICATE('0', 4) + CAST(COUNT(OD_JOB_NO) + 1 AS VARCHAR(4)), 4) AS CNT_STR FROM TB_ECM_OD_PANTOS_ABNORMAL WHERE HBL_NO = #{hblNo};

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectAddPopupMrnSearchList : 하기결과이상보고 무적MFN MRN 조회(반입예정데이터) */ SELECT SUBSTRING(CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 1, 11) AS mrn , MBL_NO AS mblNo , VESSEL_FLIGHT AS vesselFlight , AR_DATE AS arDate , ORIG_COUNTRY AS origCountry FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE 1=1
AND ${srchDateGbn} >= CONVERT(CHAR(10), #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
AND ${srchDateGbn} < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CONVERT(CHAR(10), #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat}))
AND ISNULL(ORIG_COUNTRY, '') <> '' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 1, 11), MBL_NO, VESSEL_FLIGHT, AR_DATE, ORIG_COUNTRY ORDER BY AR_DATE DESC, VESSEL_FLIGHT, ORIG_COUNTRY

/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectAddPopupNoCargoData : 하기결과이상보고 - 무적 MFN 추가 팝업 데이터 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 OD_JOB_NO , MRN , MSN , HSN , ORIG_COUNTRY , VESSEL_FLIGHT , AR_DATE , MBL_NO , HBL_NO , EX_CT AS PIECES , EX_WT AS GWT , PIECES AS HBL_PIECES , GWT AS HBL_GWT , EX_CT AS CNT , 'MFN' AS ABNORMAL_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD_PANTOS_ABNORMAL P WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ( MRN = #{mrn} AND HBL_NO = #{hblNo} AND ABNORMAL_CODE = #{abnormalCode} ) OR ( MRN = #{mrn} AND HBL_NO = #{hblNo} AND ABNORMAL_CODE = 'MGN' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE SUBSTRING(CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 1, 11) = #{mrn} AND MBL_NO = #{mblNo} AND HBL_NO = #{hblNo} AND IN_YN = 'Y' ) )
/* BmsCargoAbnormalMapper.selectMaxRemarksNo : 하기이상코드 무적MFN 추가 비고 조회 */ SELECT ISNULL(MAX(REMARKS), 8999) FROM TB_ECM_OD_PANTOS_ABNORMAL WHERE MRN = #{mrn}
